title: Coordenador de arquitetura de dados
description:
Sobre a área:A área de Arquitetura de Dados é responsável por definir, estruturar e sustentar as bases tecnológicas que permitem a coleta, o processamento, a integração e o consumo de dados de forma segura, escalável e alinhada às estratégias do negócio. Atua na definição de padrões, políticas e modelos arquiteturais, garantindo a qualidade, governança e disponibilidade das informações para apoiar análises, produtos de dados e a tomada de decisão em toda a organização.Além do aspecto técnico, a área trabalha de forma colaborativa com times de TI, Analytics e áreas de negócio, antecipando necessidades, avaliando tecnologias emergentes e propondo soluções inovadoras. Seu papel é viabilizar uma arquitetura robusta e sustentável, que suporte o crescimento da empresa, promova eficiência operacional e fortaleça a cultura orientada a dados.Principais atividades:Coordenar atividades operacionais do time de Arquitetura e Plataforma de Dados.
Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de arquiteturas de dados alinhadas aos objetivos
organizacionais.
Participação em processos de recrutamento e desenvolvimento de talentos e desligamento de
profissionais.
Fomentar o desenvolvimento técnico da equipe, promovendo um ambiente de aprendizado contínuo
e desenvolvimento de habilidades.
Interagir com líderes de outras áreas para entender suas necessidades analíticas.
Participação na gestão de orçamentos e recursos.
Relatar os resultados para a gerência e recomendar melhorias.
Tomar decisões relacionadas à arquitetura de dados
Estabelecer e fazer cumprir padrões e políticas relacionadas ao uso de dados.
Definir estratégias de Gestão e moldar a direção técnica.
Resolver desafios complexos e inovadores.
Estabelecer parcerias estratégicas.
Fomentar a disseminação de uma cultura organizacional que valorize a utilização eficaz de dados na
tomada de decisões.
Acompanhamento de tendências em engenharia de dados e aplicação de tecnologias emergentes
Colaboração com equipes de TI e outras áreas
Participação na gestão de contratos com fornecedores
Participação nos processos de definição de novos cargos ou novas expertises necessárias às funções
do setor
Acompanhamento de registros de ponto; alinhamento das férias, folgas remuneradas e banco de
horas
Verificação e orientação sobre atestados médicos e licenças e participação em iniciativas de saúde e
suporte ao bem-estar
Contribuição para políticas de remuneração, benefícios, reconhecimento, incentivos, feedback e
mentorias
Participação no desenvolvimento de planos de carreira, treinamento e desenvolvimento individual
Abertura, acompanhamento e finalização de chamados de TIBuscamos alguém que apresente:Graduação completa ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática,
Engenharia ou área correlata.
Inglês intermediário (desejável avançado para leitura)
Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Jira, Project)
Experiência com gestão de pessoas.
Experiência em liderança para recrutar, delegar e motivar um time de profissionais de dados.
Experiência em desenvolvimento de talentos e gestão de desempenho.
Experiência em gestão de orçamento para alocar recursos de maneira eficiente.
Visão estratégica de negócios e do time de dados.
Experiência em gestão de projetos de dadosConhecimentos Técnicos:Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C): Expertise em ferramentas de Ia C como Terraform, Pulumi e
Cloud Formation.
Plataformas de Dados: Expertise em Databricks, incluindo gerenciamento e otimização de clusters.
Computação em Nuvem: Experiência avançada com AWS, incluindo serviços como EC2, S3, Lambda,
RDS, EMR, Glue, Athena e Sage Maker. Conhecimento em GCP e Azure é um diferencial.
Ferramentas de CDC: Conhecimento e uso de ferramentas de CDC, entendo os tradeoffs entre as
diferentes ferramentas e quando faz sentido usar cada.
Armazenamento e Arquitetura de Dados: Conhecimento profundo em arquiteturas de data
lakehouse, incluindo Delta Lake e a estrutura Medallion.
Deploy de Modelos de Machine Learning: Experiência avançada no deploy e monitoramento de
modelos de machine learning.
Ferramentas de ETL e Orquestração: Expertise com Apache Airflow, dbt, e outras ferramentas de ETL.
Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência avançada em Python e SQL.
Boas Práticas de Engenharia de Software: Aplicação de princípios de engenharia de software, como
controle de versão, testes automatizados, integração contínua e deploy contínuo (CI/CD).
Governança de Dados: Expertise em políticas de governança de dados, incluindo a gestão de dados
sensíveis e privados, conformidade com regulamentos (ex: LGPD), e uso de catálogos de dados para
garantir a acessibilidade e qualidade dos dados.Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;
• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;
• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;
• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;
• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;
• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.Informações da vaga:
Modelo de Trabalho (Home Office)
Carga Horária: 220h
Escala: Segunda a sexta
Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!Saúde e Bem-estar:
• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;
• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;
• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;
• Acesso à plataforma Oriente Me para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;
• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;
• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.Proteção e estabilidade:
• Previdência privada;
• Participação nos lucros;
• Seguro de vida.Facilidades para o dia a dia:
• Vale-Alimentação;
• Vale-Refeição;
• Vale-Transporte;
• Auxílio-Creche;
• Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.Desenvolvimento e educação:
• Plataforma de ensino;
• Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.Para conhecer mais sobre o Grupo Fleury, acesse o site:

title: It service desk - advanced english
description:
What a day in the life looks like:
Provide frontline support via phone and ticketing systems to resolve software-related issues.
Gather key details to assess and triage cases to the appropriate internal teams.
Maintain accurate, detailed documentation within the ticketing system.
Ensure timely responses and resolutions in line with defined SLAs.
Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and partners to drive case resolution.
Use empathy, active listening, and emotional intelligence to ensure excellent customer experiences.What you bring to the team:
BA/BS Degree, Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent.
3 years of technical customer support experience.
Excellent verbal and written communication in English.
Experience or industry knowledge in supply chain software such as warehouse management solutions or order/ inventory management solutions.
Experience in database (SQL / Oracle) queries and stored procedures.
Experience with operating systems and RF hardware.
Experience with labeling software (e.g., Bartender) and voice solutions such as Honeywell is a plus.
Familiarity with Service Now or other industry-standard ticketing systems is preferred.
Fluency in English. MandatoryYou Are Skilled With And Have Significant Experience WithSupply chain and distribution industry knowledge and experience.
Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) expertise in Red Prairie (JDA), Manhattan Associates, SAP- WM, Oracle-WM, Accellos, Infor, etc.
Barcode scanning and RF hardware (Intermec, LXE, Motorola, Symbol)
Labeling (Bartender or Loftware) experience a plus
Reporting (Cognos, Business Objects, SSRS) experience a plus
Networking (Cisco, WAN/LAN, troubleshooting)Why join us?
At Infios, we're not just looking for employees; we're looking for partners in innovation, growth, and purpose. Meeting you where you are to create the future you need is at the core of who we are and what we do. Whether you're at the beginning of your career or a seasoned expert, we meet you on your journey, equipping you with the tools and opportunities to build the future you envision. Together, we will relentlessly work toward one common goal - making supply chains better.

title: Bilingual civil engineer (load analysis: structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems)
description:
The Company
Datamtx ( / formerly Datamatics) established in 1993 and globally HQ'd in Atlanta has a stellar history supporting both Tier 1 and 2 Manufacturing ERP rollouts ranging from implementations, data cleanse, migrations, customization, hypercare and Day 1 support. We are also nationally aligned with leading accounting firms & VARs.
Our ERP / CRM coverage includes: SAP, Oracle EBS/Fusion, Oracle Cloud ERP, Peoplesoft, JDE, Infor (M3, LX, XA, LN, System 21), IFS, Epicor, Sys Pro, D365 & Salesforce.
One of our longest standing service verticals has been assisting transition clients from legacy systems to cloud based platforms including introduction of Cloud / Gen AI and MS-Fabric, RAG models.We are seeking a multipleCivil Engineerswith emphasis on Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems.
English language proficiency is mandatory.These are remote roles.This is a Civil Engineering client who are a market leader in the renewable energy industry. Ideally, they would like to start someone by early February for 11 months with an option to extend annually.ROLES:
1) Civil Engineers(3+ years of experience)
2) Associate Civil Engineer: ACE(0-3 years of experience)Executive Summary
Our client is dedicated to maintaining high-volume production speeds without compromising the rigorous structural safety and code compliance standards required for a 25-year system life. We require a scalable solution where a vendor-managed team can execute technical reviews, resolve engineering escalations, and maintain seamless communication across our design-to-installation pipeline.Primary Duties
Reviewing structural conditions of rooftops and framing systems
Designing or verifying the configuration of racking and attachment systems
Performing load analysis to ensure compliance with applicable safety standards and expected performance over a 25-year system life
Working in a high-volume production environment, completing multiple project assessments per day, with some engineers averaging multiple evaluations per hour
The ability to maintain accuracy and consistency at scale is critical.
Regular shifting of work schedule may be required to support seasonal business needs
Turnaround Times: Core tasks are measured in business hours with expectations ranging from 4 to 24 hours depending on the task type.
Quality & Accountability: Staff must maintain a 95% quality score ; consistent failure to meet these standards requires a Performance Improvement Plan within 10 business days.Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or higher in an engineering discipline, with preference for civil or structural engineering
Professional accreditation or licensure in their home country (preferred but not mandatory)
Proficiency in technical analysis and structural design tools is a plus but not required
Strong English communication skills for coordination with US-based engineering leadsExperience level
Associate Civil Engineer-ACE: 0–3 years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field
Civil Engineer: 3+ years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field

title: Analista de infraestrutura (iot)
description:
Atribuições:
Gestão de Redes e Infraestrutura: Planejamento, configuração e manutenção de redes de dados, voz e fibra óptica.
Desenvolvimento e Integração: Criação de soluções que integram componentes eletrônicos (hardware) com aplicações de software, incluindo sistemas Io T e protocolos de comunicação.
Segurança da Informação: Implementação de medidas de proteção, firewalls e controle de acesso para garantir a segurança dos dados.
Suporte e Otimização: Monitoramento de desempenho, reparo de sistemas e identificação de melhorias para aumentar a eficiência operacional.Localidade:RemotoFundada em 1982, a Softtek é uma fornecedora global de soluções de TI orientadas a processos com 30 escritórios na América do Norte, América Latina, Europa e Ásia. Com 15 centros de entrega global nos EUA, México, China, Brasil, Argentina, Costa Rica, Espanha, Hungria e Índia, a Softtek ajuda a melhorar e produzir resultados previsíveis para corporações de primeira linha em mais de 20 países. A Softtek é a criadora e líder da indústria nearshore.Para obter mais informações sobre o que fazemos, quem somos e oportunidades de carreira, visite no Twitter e seja nosso fã no Facebook e inclusãoA Softtek valoriza a diversidade e inclusão em sua força de trabalho. A empresa tem uma equipe global com pessoas de diferentes origens e culturas, o que torna o ambiente de trabalho mais rico e interessante.
Independentemente da sua ,etnia, idade, gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência, credo ou convicção política, o que importa são as suas competências e habilidades para fazer acontecer.Os Softtekians são seres humanos talentosos e auto-determinados que se consideram pessoas loucamente incríveis! Venha fazer parte desse time!!!Quer saber mais? Acesse:
se candidate para essa vaga seus dados ficarão armazenados em nosso banco de dados, atendendo a privacidade de dados conforme à Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados, lei nº 13.709/2018.
Caso não tenha interesse em manter suas informações pessoais em nosso banco de dados, solicitamos nos encaminhar um e-mail para.
Dúvidas também podem ser enviadas ao e-mail

title: Bilingual civil engineer (load analysis: structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems)
description:
The Company
Datamtx ( / formerly Datamatics) established in 1993 and globally HQ'd in Atlanta has a stellar history supporting both Tier 1 and 2 Manufacturing ERP rollouts ranging from implementations, data cleanse, migrations, customization, hypercare and Day 1 support. We are also nationally aligned with leading accounting firms & VARs.
Our ERP / CRM coverage includes: SAP, Oracle EBS/Fusion, Oracle Cloud ERP, Peoplesoft, JDE, Infor (M3, LX, XA, LN, System 21), IFS, Epicor, Sys Pro, D365 & Salesforce.
One of our longest standing service verticals has been assisting transition clients from legacy systems to cloud based platforms including introduction of Cloud / Gen AI and MS-Fabric, RAG models.We are seeking a multipleCivil Engineerswith emphasis on Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems.
English language proficiency is mandatory.These are remote roles.This is a Civil Engineering client who are a market leader in the renewable energy industry. Ideally, they would like to start someone by early February for 11 months with an option to extend annually.ROLES:

Our client is dedicated to maintaining high-volume production speeds without compromising the rigorous structural safety and code compliance standards required for a 25-year system life. We require a scalable solution where a vendor-managed team can execute technical reviews, resolve engineering escalations, and maintain seamless communication across our design-to-installation pipeline.Primary Duties
Reviewing structural conditions of rooftops and framing systems
Designing or verifying the configuration of racking and attachment systems
Performing load analysis to ensure compliance with applicable safety standards and expected performance over a 25-year system life
Working in a high-volume production environment, completing multiple project assessments per day, with some engineers averaging multiple evaluations per hour
The ability to maintain accuracy and consistency at scale is critical.
Regular shifting of work schedule may be required to support seasonal business needs
Turnaround Times: Core tasks are measured in business hours with expectations ranging from 4 to 24 hours depending on the task type.
Quality & Accountability: Staff must maintain a 95% quality score ; consistent failure to meet these standards requires a Performance Improvement Plan within 10 business days.Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or higher in an engineering discipline, with preference for civil or structural engineering
Professional accreditation or licensure in their home country (preferred but not mandatory)
Proficiency in technical analysis and structural design tools is a plus but not required
Strong English communication skills for coordination with US-based engineering leadsExperience level
Associate Civil Engineer-ACE: 0–3 years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field
Civil Engineer: 3+ years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field

organizacionais.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas.
Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.Necessário:Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?
Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dadoscom bancos relacionais e não relacionais(Postgre SQL, Mongo DB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.
Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, comoAzure, GCP e AWS.
Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.
Definir arquitetura de softwaree padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas deDev Ops, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
Mentorar desenvolvedoresde diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.
Contribuir estrategicamentepara decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.O que nós estamos procurando;Formação:Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.
Experiência solida (+5 anos):em desenvolvimento web comReact, Next.js, Java Script e Type Script.
Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e No SQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.
Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
Experiência prática com Dev Ops e CI/CD , uso deDocker ,Kubernetese ferramentas de integração contínua.
Visão arquiteturale capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.
Inglês fluente(para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).O que oferecemos;

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.
Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.Role summary:
Lead the design and operation of APIs that power Server-Driven UI for Flutter clients while owning backend services across the stack. You’ll design stable UI contracts and compose client payloads, be comfortable diving into other backend codebases to implement features and fix production issues, participate in the on-call rotation to keep services healthy and low-latency, and drive team capability for SDUI.Key responsibilities:
Design and implement robust RESTful APIs for SDUI, auth, and rate limiting.
Implement composition/templating logic that returns client-ready UI payloads with capability-aware fallbacks.
Champion SDUI capability across the team: coach engineers, run hands-on workshops, create onboarding/docs, and promote SDUI best practices.
Work across multiple backend repositories: add features, refactor, and maintain code quality.
Operate production services: own SLAs, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and participate in on-call rotation.
Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing).
Build and maintain CI/CD, testing, and observability (metrics, tracing, logs, dashboards).
Integrate personalization, experimentation hooks, and feature flags into the delivery flow.
Collaborate closely with mobile/web teams to define contracts and client compatibility.
Mentor peers, lead design reviews, and drive API and schema governance and backward-compatibility practices.Required skills & experience:
7+ years building production microservices and APIs.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with active participation in team ceremonies and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design.
Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) experience, including effective use of abstraction and dependency injection patterns to build modular, testable, and maintainable backend systems.
Hands-on development inType Scriptfor backend services.
Proven RESTful API design and contract experience.
Solid experience with databases and caching technologies, such as Postgre SQL, My SQL, and Redis, with an understanding of data modeling, query performance, and cache strategies.
Strong withAWS(API Gateway/Lambda or ECS/EC2, S3, Cloud Front, RDS/Elasti Cache or equivalents).
Experience with containerization using Docker (image build, Docker Compose, registries, running services in containers).
Strong testing experience, including automated testing and manual verification.
Experience with production support: alerting, runbooks, incident management, and on-call duties.
Familiar with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling (Prometheus, Open Telemetry, etc.).
Good spoken EnglishNice to have:
Terraform or other Ia C for managing AWS resources.
Experience instrumenting endpoints and surfacing behavior in analytics platforms such as Amplitude (event schemas, dashboards, alerts).
Experience using Statsig, Grafana, and Sentry for experimentation, dashboards, error tracking, and incident diagnostics.
Protobuf experience (service/event schema management via service-protos).
Background in personalization/experimentation systems.
Hands-on development in Python for backend services.Hiring signals:
Examples of evolving APIs without breaking clients and measurable reliability/performance improvements.
Proven track record of mentoring and up-skilling engineers—especially enabling teams to adopt and own SDUI patterns.
Evidence of effective on-call ownership: resolved incidents, improved runbooks/alerts, postmortems.
Code that shows strong testing, observability, and cross-repo contributions.Perks:
We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
Health/Sport budget
Remote work
Flexible PTO
Global offices
Fun, positive, collaborative environment!

Conceitos de Estatística e Geoestatística;
Conhecimento em SQL/No SQL;
Experiência em algoritmos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning;
Experiência em assistentes e agentes de IA integrados a modelos LLM;
Manipulação de dados espaço-temporais (geográficos com componente temporal);
Desejável conhecimento em sistemas de informação geográfica, sensoriamento remoto, geoprocessamento e análises eResponsabilidades e atribuições:
Realizar tarefas regulares como: entendimento do problema de negócio, requisitos da solução, exploração de dados, treinamento e execução de modelos de Deep Learning e Machine Learning, análises estatísticas e geoestatísticas, configuração de fluxos de automação de processamento dos dados, confecção de relatórios e painéis de apresentação de informações;
Compreender as necessidades do negócio, fornecer insights acionáveis e recomendações com base nas análises e traduzi-las em proposição de solução;

Aplicar técnicas de sensoriamento remoto para definição de soluções de mapeamento de uso e cobertura do solo através da visão computacional para interpretação de imagens de satélite e/ou radar;
Testar e validar soluções de ciência de dados para garantir sua eficácia, qualidade e atendimento aos requisitos;
Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e avanços na área de ciência de dados;
Participar e promover discussões técnicas e processos de ideação / inovação. Contribuindo para um ambiente de confiança, liberdade e troca, propício à criatividade;
Colaborar com a equipe de Data Science na construção de soluções.Por que escolher a Geosistemas?Saúde e Bem-Estar:

title: Revenue operations associate
description:
About Us:Yipit Data is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475 M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1 B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.
Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.
We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.What It’s Like to Work at Yipit Data:
Yipit Data isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.
From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.
Why Top Talent Chooses Yipit Data:
Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
Velocity with Purpose:We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention
If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—Yipit Data might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.About Spend Hound:
Spend Houndis a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm Yipit Data. (See thisintroductory videofrom Spend Hound’s Senior Product Manager!)
Spend Hound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
Companies use the Spend Hound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.
Spend Hound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of Yipit Data market research (example report).About The Role:
Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?
We are seeking aRevenue Operations Associateto play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, Spend Hound. As a fast-growing “start-up” within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.We expect East work hours.As our Revenue Operations Associate, you will partner with our Sales and Marketing teams to:
Be an operations subject matter expert for the Sales function, working closely with Rev Ops and Spendhound leadership to support Sales and execute on key initiatives
Implement processes and solutions that can streamline revenue acquisition and eliminate inefficiencies
Maintain and measure various components of the Sales process, such as
Target/Territory Management
Lead Generation, and
Outbound Cadence Operations.
Ensure that the Sales teams are operating seamlessly through data evaluation and by improving workflowsYou Are Likely To Succeed If:
Operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team.
You demonstrate a high aptitude for organization, process development, project and change management, and analytics
You have advanced Excel skills
Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
You have advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)
You are committed to continuously improving yourself and helping those around youWhat We Offer:
Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
Flexible work schedule
Personal laptop
Health and wellness package
Remote work
Your growth at Yipit Data is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at Yipit Data is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Senior sre/platform engineer (python/go)
description:
About the role
Skyflow is a data privacy vault delivered via APIs. It helps companies isolate, protect, govern, and use sensitive data such as personal, health, or payment information securely, without losing usability. It’s built on a zero-trust architecture, meaning no one gets access to data unless explicitly allowed.
Skyflow is looking for a Platform Engineer to support the SRE team and help design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and infrastructure. This role combines strong backend development skills with knowledge of SRE practices, contributing to the reliability, automation, and optimization of production systems. The Platform Engineer will collaborate closely with SREs, engineers, and business teams to ensure systems are performant, maintainable, and scalable.Requirements
5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on platform and infrastructure development
Experience supporting infrastructure, automation, or reliability practices (SRE exposure is a plus)
Proficiency in backend programming languages such as Python or Go
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred)
Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform, Cloud Formation), and automation
Hands-on experience with RDBMS and distributed systems

As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting Move Up Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and i Gaming innovations
Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.The ideal profileWe’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.You are someone who:Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
Has i Gaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing itYou bring strong CM fundamentals:High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
Ownership mindset over site and content performance
Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
Experience working with CMS platformsYou work well with others and think ahead:Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potentialFeeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.Next steps in the process ✅1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with Move Up Media
Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!What’s in it for youA full time remote work environment.
A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun. We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!Move Up MediaWe're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of i Gaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!Our approachWe focus on people. We put end users' experience as a priority on all strategies and processes. Thus, we aim to make complex topics easy to understand and provide exactly what our audience is seeking. We achieve this by carefully analyzing data and reflecting upon it, writing the content with care, and ensuring a smooth user experience.

Extensive expertise of RDBMS, Python, Hadoop, SQL and Pyspark.

Hands on Java experience

Experience of ETL/ELT technical design, automated testing of engineering pipelines, quality assurance and documentation.

Willingness to learn new tools and techniques; proactively keeping up to date with latest thinking and practices.
Able to establish what does/doesn’t align to business/functional strategies/priorities and communicate dependencies clearly.
Able to drive the adoption of best practice approaches to data engineering, coaching, and supporting the wider data engineering team.
Embrace change with a positive outlook.
Confident to challenge, and receptive to being challenged.
The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.Join Our Global Team:We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. title: Revenue operations associate
description:
About Us:
Yipit Data is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475 M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1 B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.
Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.
We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.What It’s Like to Work at Yipit Data:
Yipit Data isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.
From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.
Why Top Talent Chooses Yipit Data:
Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
Velocity with Purpose:We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention
If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—Yipit Data might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.About Spend Hound:
Spend Houndis a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm Yipit Data. (See thisintroductory videofrom Spend Hound’s Senior Product Manager!)
Spend Hound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
Companies use the Spend Hound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.
Spend Hound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of Yipit Data market research ( example report ).About The Role:
Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?
We are seeking aRevenue Operations Associateto play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, Spend Hound. As a fast-growing “start-up” within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.We expect East work hours.As our Revenue Operations Associate, you will partner with our Sales and Marketing teams to:
Be an operations subject matter expert for the Sales function, working closely with Rev Ops and Spendhound leadership to support Sales and execute on key initiatives
Implement processes and solutions that can streamline revenue acquisition and eliminate inefficiencies
Maintain and measure various components of the Sales process, such as
Target/Territory Management
Lead Generation, and
Outbound Cadence Operations.
Ensure that the Sales teams are operating seamlessly through data evaluation and by improving workflowsYou Are Likely To Succeed If:
Operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team.
You demonstrate a high aptitude for organization, process development, project and change management, and analytics
You have advanced Excel skills
Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
You have advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)
You are committed to continuously improving yourself and helping those around youWhat We Offer:
Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
Flexible work schedule
Personal laptop
Health and wellness package
Remote work
Your growth at Yipit Data is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at Yipit Data is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Senior content manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting Move Up Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.To be more specific, you will:Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and i Gaming innovations
Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.The ideal profileWe’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.You are someone who:Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
Has i Gaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing itYou bring strong CM fundamentals:High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
Ownership mindset over site and content performance
Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
Experience working with CMS platformsYou work well with others and think ahead:Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potentialFeeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.Next steps in the process ✅1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with Move Up Media
Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!What’s in it for youA full time remote work environment.
A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun. We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!Move Up MediaWe're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of i Gaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!Our approachWe focus on people. We put end users' experience as a priority on all strategies and processes. Thus, we aim to make complex topics easy to understand and provide exactly what our audience is seeking. We achieve this by carefully analyzing data and reflecting upon it, writing the content with care, and ensuring a smooth user experience.

title: Principal data engineer
description:
Description
We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.
This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.

Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and Dynamo DB.

Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.Technology Requirements
5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
Experience writing production Type Script.
Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or Postgre SQL.
Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
Advanced SQL skills.
Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.Profile Requirements
Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

title: Automotive product owner
description:
Project Description:
This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.
Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.
The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.Responsibilities:

fixes, improvements, and release work
• Support new accessibility features by preparing, refining, and tracking requirements and acceptance
criteria with stakeholder
• Clarify functional, UX, and accessibility requirements with stakeholders and engineering
• Ensure backlog items are well-defined, testable, and ready for implementationSprint, PI & Delivery Execution

• Coordinate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and execution tracking
• Monitor progress, dependencies, and risks across sprints and PIs
• Sequence and balance work within agreed priorities and constraints to support timely deliveryAccessibility, Quality & Change Coordination

• Assess and document impacts, dependencies, and delivery risks, especially where accessibility or
compliance may be affected
• Highlight trade-offs and potential impacts early and transparently
• Escalate complex or high-impact topics to the appropriate stakeholders
Release & Operational Ownership

communication

• Track release quality, regression risks, and production issues
• Coordinate verification activities on test benches and organize debugging sessions when required
• Management of test specifications (update existing test specifications if required, create test runs for
external testers, etc.)Stakeholder Communication
• Represent the team and topic in stakeholder meetings, like calls with VW Group brands or
representatives of legal and regulatory departments
• Act as the primary coordination point for day-to-day delivery and release topics
• Communicate progress, risks, and release status clearly and consistently
• Support alignment between product, UX, engineering, and validation stakeholdersMandatory Skills Description:
Product & Delivery Execution
• Proven experience in Product Owner, Technical Program Manager, Delivery Lead or Release Engineer roles
• Strong ability to manage end-to-end delivery in a complex, cross-functional environment
• Experience managing multiple release timelines
• Hands-on experience with backlog management, refinement, and sprint execution
• Ability to sequence and coordinate work within agreed prioritiesQuality & Compliance Mindset
• Experience working with quality-critical or compliance-driven requirements
• Strong attention to detail and traceability (requirements → implementation → validation)
• Ability to manage high-risk changes where small defects can have large impactRelease & Operational Skills
• Experience coordinating software releases end to end
• Ability to track release readiness, risks, and regressions
• Comfort working with production or preproduction environments (e.g. test benches)Tools & Ways of Working
• Experience working with distributed or nearshore teams
• Strong hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence
• Solid understanding of agile software development (Scrum, SAFe)
• Ability to operate independently with limited guidanceStakeholder & Pressure Handling
• Proven ability to work with hands-off stakeholders who escalate under failure
• Strong communication skills: clear, calm, and structured under pressure
• Ability to anticipate issues, surface risks early, and drive resolution
• Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalateNice-to-Have Skills Description:
Domain & Platform Experience

• Familiarity with Android Automotive or embedded platforms
• Exposure to in-car UX, HMI, or accessibility topicsAccessibility & UX Awareness

title: Senior sre/platform engineer (python/go)
description:
About the role
Skyflow is a data privacy vault delivered via APIs. It helps companies isolate, protect, govern, and use sensitive data such as personal, health, or payment information securely, without losing usability. It’s built on a zero-trust architecture, meaning no one gets access to data unless explicitly allowed.
Skyflow is looking for a Platform Engineer to support the SRE team and help design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and infrastructure. This role combines strong backend development skills with knowledge of SRE practices, contributing to the reliability, automation, and optimization of production systems. The Platform Engineer will collaborate closely with SREs, engineers, and business teams to ensure systems are performant, maintainable, and scalable.Requirements
5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on platform and infrastructure development
Experience supporting infrastructure, automation, or reliability practices (SRE exposure is a plus)
Proficiency in backend programming languages such as Python or Go
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred)
Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform, Cloud Formation), and automation
Hands-on experience with RDBMS and distributed systems
Ability to work collaboratively with SRE and engineering teams to support production systems
Understanding of application observability, monitoring, and performance best practices
Good spoken EnglishResponsibilities:
Develop automation and tooling to improve system monitoring, incident response, and operational efficiency.
Build and maintain infrastructure as code using Ia C technologies like Terraform and Cloud Formation.
Collaborate with engineering teams to design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant architectures.
Write production-grade code (Python or Go) to automate infrastructure management and operational workflows.
Establish and enhance observability practices, including metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting.
Participate in on-call rotations, incident management, and post-incident reviews to drive continuous improvement.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation to support reliable software delivery.
Partner with developers to embed reliability and performance best practices throughout the development lifecycle.We offer:
We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
Personal laptop.
Health/Sport Budget.
Fully remote.

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. title: Engenheiro de plataforma - especialista (sre)
description:
Prazer, Grupo SBF
Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil.Responsabilidades e atribuições
Atuar em projetos sendo responsável pela confiabilidade e escalabilidade de sistemas.
Definir padrões e melhores práticas de Dev Ops na empresa.
Resolver incidentes críticos e complexos de maneira eficaz.
Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento na construção de sistemas altamente resilientes.
Contribuir para a pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias relacionadas à Dev Ops, SRE e Platform Engineering.
Colaborar com a difusão de novas tecnologias/melhores práticas através de palestras e apresentações.
Otimizar e melhorar a eficiência do uso dos recursos e reduzir o custo
Conhecer os dados operacionais dos produtos providos pelo time e utilização como base para impulsionar mudanças a fim de obter estabilidade e melhorias de desempenho.
Atuar como mentor principal para o restante da equipe na atuação em projetos, operação e momentos de crise.Requisitos e qualificações
Sólidos conhecimentos sistemas de computação em nuvem, automação e orquestração de infraestrutura;
Domínio na implantação e gerenciamento de pipelines de CI/CD utilizando containers e orquestração;
Conhecimentos avançados em arquitetura de micro serviços, segurança da informação e práticas de conformidades
Conhecimentos em infraestrutura como Código (Ia C);
Experiência em desenvolvimento de Api's e serviços web usando frameworks como flask (phyton);
Conhecimentos em banco de dados e armazenamento de dados distribuídos;
Domínio com ferramentas de monitoramento e alertas;
Domínio de plataformas de analise e visualização de métricas;
Domínio de ferramentas de rastreamento distribuídos para monitorar transações em ambientes complexos;
Domínio em ferramentas de centralização de logs e analise em tempo real;
Conhecimentos avançados com plataformas de IDP para fomentar a necessidade dos times de engenharia provendo camada de abstração para infraestrutura.

Valorizamos a pluralidade e buscamos proporcionar soluções para negócios de todos os tamanhos e segmentos, atendendo de pequenos empreendedores a grandes corporações.Desde 2012, atuamos no mercado brasileiro com o investimento e a expertise do grupo Cimpress, líder global em customização em massa. title: Principal data engineer
description:
Description
We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.
This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.Responsibilities
Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
Write production-ready Type Script code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and Dynamo DB.
Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.Technology Requirements
5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
Experience writing production Type Script.
Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or Postgre SQL.
Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
Advanced SQL skills.
Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.Profile Requirements
Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

title: Human resources manager (middle level)
description:
About the Job
Turn Key is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our Turn Key team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U. S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, Yipit Data, Work Ramp, and Bell Xcel.
We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.OurHR Managerwill take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.

title: Senior c/c++ engineer with python
description:
Project Description:
Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.
Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.Responsibilities:
As a software engineer, you will be working on Linux server applications for metrology components and on complex algorithms application software. You will be working with electrical engineers, mechatronic engineers and system engineers to define the software requirements.
A team of about 10 people consisting of a team lead, a sw architect, a few senior developers. After your SW design is approved you are responsible for implementing the design in Python & C for new modules.
During testing, you will collect the necessary data so you can write a test report.
The development environment is Red Hat Linux, execution environment is Wind River Linux. The software release driving a client machine is 40 million lines of code. Client SW teams work in various modes such as Agile and SAFE.Mandatory Skills Description:
We are looking for colleagues with at least 5 years of development experience.
Python: application coding
Linux (one of more of the following): familiar with command line tools, makefile, git, shell and python scripting
Embedded C and C++: understanding and maintaining legacy code. Adding new features while keeping compliance with established architecture.
Version control using command line is also required - Git, Clear Case and SVN, in this order of priority.Languages:
English: C1 Advanced

title: Senior c/c++ engineer with python
description:

Embedded C and C++: understanding and maintaining legacy code. Adding new features while keeping compliance with established architecture.
Version control using command line is also required - Git, Clear Case and SVN, in this order of priority.Languages:
English: C1 Advanced

title: Cientista de dados (produto rh)
description:
Descrição da vaga
A missão do Cientista de Dados será atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas para um produto de Analytics voltado a softwares de RH, contribuindo com a análise e modelagem de dados voltados à gestão de pessoas e processos. Fará parte de um time multidisciplinar responsável por criar modelos preditivos, gerar insights estratégicos e estruturar pipelines de dados eficientes.

Trabalhar em equipe no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas aplicadas ao contexto de Recursos Humanos.
Realizar exploração, tratamento e modelagem de dados para gerar insights estratégicos.
Desenvolver modelos estatísticos e preditivos voltados à análise de comportamento, desempenho e gestão de pessoas.
Atuar na implementação, ajuste fino e avaliação de desempenho de LLMs aplicados ao produto.
Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções baseadas em dados.
Contribuir com a documentação técnica e boas práticas de ciência de dados.
Colaborar com times de produto, engenharia e UX para garantir integração fluida das soluções ao produto final.
Participar de testes, validações e iterações de modelos em ambiente de produção.
Acompanhar tendências e inovações na área de dados e inteligência artificial, especialmente em aplicações de RH.O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:
Graduação completa em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Engenharia, Matemática, Computação ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência prática com modelagem estatística, machine learning e análise exploratória de dados.
Domínio de linguagens como Python (pandas, scikit-learn, Num Py, etc.) e SQL.
Conhecimento em conceitos e aplicações de LLMs (Large Language Models).
Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções analíticas.
Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar.SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE:
Experiência prévia com dados de RH ou People Analytics.
Conhecimento de ferramentas de visualização (ex: Metabase, Power BI, Tableau, Dash, etc.).
Experiência com deployment de modelos em ambiente de produção.
